description: This file contains utility functions and types for managing session delivery, including resolving channels, session keys, and retiring legacy delivery routes in a messaging system.

classes.name: LegacyMainDeliveryRetirement
classes.description: Type representing a retired legacy main delivery route with key and session entry.

methods.name: resolveSessionKeyChannelHint
methods.description: Resolves a message channel hint from a session key.

methods.name: isMainSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if a session key corresponds to the main session.

methods.name: hasStrictDirectSessionTail
methods.description: Determines if a session key has a strict direct session tail based on parts and marker index.

methods.name: isDirectSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if a session key indicates a direct session.

methods.name: isExternalRoutingChannel
methods.description: Checks if a channel is an external routing channel.

methods.name: resolveLastChannelRaw
methods.description: Resolves the last channel raw value based on parameters and session state.

methods.name: resolveLastToRaw
methods.description: Resolves the last 'to' raw value based on parameters and session state.

methods.name: maybeRetireLegacyMainDeliveryRoute
methods.description: Determines if a legacy main delivery route should be retired based on session context.
